versions.subject: feat: new rules, updates and fp fixes (#4162)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cli_enc:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -e'
selection_cli_invoke:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Invoke-
        # UTF-16LE
        - 'SQBuAHYAbwBrAGUALQ'
        - 'kAbgB2AG8AawBlAC0A'
        - 'JAG4AdgBvAGsAZQAtA'
        # UTF-8
        - 'SW52b2tlL'
        - 'ludm9rZS'
        - 'JbnZva2Ut'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine="* -e*" CommandLine IN ("*SQBuAHYAbwBrAGUALQ*", "*kAbgB2AG8AawBlAC0A*", "*JAG4AdgBvAGsAZQAtA*", "*SW52b2tlL*", "*ludm9rZS*", "*JbnZva2Ut*")
